arg_type.description: evaluable by reflection scans only; a text scan refuses the entry

match.description: scopes scan|lint|policy|harness only; the sub-keys are ANDed

id.description: a RULE.* id, a SCAN.* id, a doctor check id, a finding id or a harness op

target.description: * | a symbol | a file | a finding id; * is refused on scope check

reason.description: a loose floor here on purpose: the schema refuses only a reason that is no reason at all, and CFG.EXEMPTIONS checks the real bound of 40 characters per entry. Raising this one crashes Ledger.read, and with it sync, every scan and the docs build, where the doctor would have named the entry and carried on

expires.description: REQUIRED for every scope but finding; ≤ recorded + 365 d

overturn_when.description: REQUIRED on scope finding; the condition under which the adjudication would be wrong

ruling.description: scope finding only; default not-a-defect. not-a-defect: the owner rules the finding is no defect, and its reason reaches every later panel and verifier as settled. scoped: a real defect the owner puts outside the round's reach; it closes the finding and is never shown as settled
